αἴρω: to take up, raise, lift up
γνωρίζω: to make known, point out, explain
διαβάλλω: to slander; to set apart; to throw across
διαλλάσσω: to change one with another, interchange, reconcile
διαφεύγω: to flee through, get away from, escape
καταισχύνω: to disgrace, dishonour, put to shame
κείρω: to cut short, shear (hair); ravage, destroy
κομίζω: to take care of, provide for
κρίνω: to pick out, choose, judge, determine
κραίνω: to accomplish, fulfil, bring to pass
μένω: to stay at home, stay where one is, not stir
μεθορμίζω: to remove from one anchorage to another
μεταβάλλω: to throw into a different position, to turn quickly
μεταπίπτω: to fall differently, undergo a change
νέμω: to deal out, distribute; dwell in (country); pasture (flock)
νεωτερίζω: to attempt anything new, make a violent
νομίζω: to have as a custom; to believe
περαίνω: to bring to an end, finish, accomplish, execute
περιπίπτω: to fall around, so as to embrace
πημαίνω: to bring into misery, plunge into ruin, undo
προσκαλέω: to call to, call on, summon
προσκομίζω: to carry, convey; mid. bring with one, bring home
σημαίνω: to shew by a sign, indicate, make known, point out
στέλλω: to set in order, to arrange, array, equip, make ready
συμβάλλω: to throw together; come together; collect, contract, contribute
συναλλάσσω: to bring into intercourse with, associate with
συντελέω: to bring quite to an end, complete, accomplish
σφάλλω: to make to fall, throw down, overthrow
τέλλω: to make to arise, accomplish (v. ἐπιτέλλω Hom.)
φαίνω: to bring to light, make to appear
φεύγω: to flee, take flight, run away
φροντίζω: to think, consider, reflect, take thought, have a care, give heed
χαρίζω: to do a favor, to oblige, to please
χρηματίζω: to negotiate, transact business, have dealings
ψηφίζω: (mid.) to vote; (act.) to count with pebbles
ἀνάσσω: to be lord, master, owner, to rule
ἀναγγέλλω: to carry back tidings of, report
ἀνακαλέω: call on, invoke; call back, recall
ἀπεῖπον: to speak out, tell out, declare (Hom.), deny, refuse, forbid
ἀφαιρέω: to take from, take away from
ἄρνυμαι: to receive for oneself, reap, win, gain, earn
ἐγκαλέω: to call in; bring a charge or accusation
ἐκτελέω: to bring quite to an end, to accomplish, achieve
ἐκφαίνω: to shew forth, bring to light, disclose, reveal, make manifest
ἐξαίρω: lift up, lift off the earth
ἐπαίρω: to lift up and set on
ἐπαμύνω: to come to aid, defend, assist
ὀτρύνω: to stir up, rouse, egg on, spur on, encourage
ὁρμίζω: to bring to a safe anchorage, bring into harbour, to moor, anchor
ὄλλυμι: to destroy, make an end of
ὑπεκτρέχω: to run out from under, escape from
ὑπερβάλλω: to throw over; outdo, surpass, postpone
